open_points.subject: project-create retry after the created project changes
open_points.text: “a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values” does not say what the create action does after a correction or another change means the first project no longer keeps those values; M01 still retains the original create request id until anonymisation
open_points.question: When the owner retries the same project-create request after the first project has been changed but not anonymised, does Registry return that project, refuse the retry, or create a second project?
options: Return the original project in its current state
Refuse the retry because the original project no longer matches the create
Treat it as a new create and mint a second project
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the retry once the original project no longer matches, without creating another project.

witness.initial: Project P was created from request id R with display name A and is active at revision 1.
events: The owner corrects P's display name to B, moving it to revision 2.
The owner retries the original create request R carrying display name A.
outcomes: Registry recognizes R and returns the existing project P, now named B.
Because P no longer keeps its creation values, Registry treats the retry as a new create and mints project Q with name A.
witness.observer: The owner sees a different project id and the catalogue either contains one project or two.
